name: Martin Villanueva
title: Developer & designer
bio: I'm a Manila-based developer who builds responsive web experiences and practical automations. I bring hands-on experience across quality assurance, e-commerce operations, IT support, and cloud-backed software projects.
about: I'm Martin, a Manila-based developer with a designer's eye and a practical, collaborative approach to solving problems. I studied Computer Science, specializing in Software Engineering, at FEU Institute of Technology (2022-2026). My experience spans e-commerce catalog operations and Python web scraping, software quality assurance for a procurement platform, technical support, and full-stack development for a machine-learning thesis project. I have also coordinated cross-functional project work and built workflow automations for scheduling, email triage, and initial HR screening. I'm open to early-career software roles and freelance collaborations where I can contribute, keep learning, and deliver dependable work.

projects.name: AI-assisted HR screening workflow
projects.description: An n8n workflow prototype using a local Gemma 4 agent to process initial applications, prepare tailored emails, and coordinate interviews.
projects.details: Built an n8n HR initial-screening workflow that reads resumes from Google Drive, sends them to a local Gemma 4 agent for evaluation, handles repeated form submissions, prepares outcome-specific emails, and schedules interviews for shortlisted applicants through Google Sheets with a two-hour scheduling window. Any real hiring outcome should remain subject to recruiter review; the AI output is not a substitute for human judgment.

projects.name: DeepBreath
projects.description: Exploring how cough-sound analysis can help make early health insights more accessible.
projects.details: A cough-sound analysis thesis project exploring preliminary pneumonia screening with ResNet-34 and logistic regression. Developed a Flask REST API for inference, deployed backend services on AWS EC2, and connected the Android application to the cloud through HTTP/JSON APIs. As project coordinator, aligned work across the Android app, backend, cloud infrastructure, and machine-learning pipeline.

projects.name: Cloud-ready workflow
projects.description: A practical deployment and testing workflow, shaped during a government tech internship.
projects.details: Worked on quality assurance, organized project files and cloud deployment configurations, and maintained database records during an internship with the Philippine Department of Information and Communications Technology.

projects.name: AI email escalation
projects.description: An n8n and local Gemma workflow that sorts incoming email and escalates sensitive messages for human review.
projects.details: Connected Gmail to a locally hosted Gemma model through n8n. The workflow assesses incoming messages, distinguishes routine messages from those requiring human intervention, and escalates high-priority or sensitive emails instead of automatically handling them.

projects.name: Automatic form scheduler
projects.description: A Zapier workflow that turns form submissions into scheduled calendar events and confirmation emails.
projects.details: Automated appointment scheduling by connecting Google Forms, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and Gmail. Form responses are recorded, calendar events are created, and confirmation emails are sent to reduce repetitive scheduling and manual data entry.

projects.name: SupportDesk CRM
projects.description: A role-based support CRM prototype for managing customers, service tickets, communication, and activity.
projects.details: Built as an AI-assisted development project using Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, and Visual Studio Copilot Agent, with React, TypeScript, Express, and JSON-file storage. The prototype includes role-based access for administrators, agents, and customers; ticket search, assignment, updates, and resolution; customer records; activity logs; and an analytics dashboard.
